title: Go: Functions
description: Define and call functions with parameters, return values, multiple returns, and named returns.

steps.title: Basic Function
steps.description: Define a function `greet` that prints `"Hi!"` and call it from `main`.
hints: The function must be defined before or after main.

verification.failureMessage: Define and call a function that prints 'Hi!'.

steps.title: Function with Parameters
steps.description: Write a function `sayHello(name string)` that prints `"Hello, NAME!"` and call it with your name.
hints: You can use fmt.Printf or string concatenation.

verification.failureMessage: Write sayHello(name string) that prints 'Hello, NAME!'.

steps.title: Return Values
steps.description: Write a function `add(a int, b int) int` that returns the sum and print the result.
hints: `func add(a int, b int) int { return a + b }`

verification.failureMessage: Write add(a, b int) int that returns a+b and print the result of 3+7.

steps.title: Multiple Returns
steps.description: Write a function `divide(a, b int) (int, int)` that returns quotient and remainder, then print both.

verification.failureMessage: Write divide(10, 3) returning quotient 3 and remainder 1.

steps.title: Named Returns
steps.description: Write a function `rectangle(w, h float64) (area, perimeter float64)` using named returns and print both.
hints: `func rectangle(w, h float64) (area, perimeter float64) { area = w * h; perimeter = 2 * (w + h); return }`
Named returns are initialized to zero.
A bare `return` returns the named values.

verification.failureMessage: Write rectangle(3, 5) returning area=15 and perimeter=16.
